Bihar Authorities Destroy Seized Illegal Liquor

Authorities in Bihar's Gopalganj district have destroyed over 14,500 liters of seized illegal liquor, including both local and foreign brands. The destruction followed legal procedures and was conducted under magistrate supervision with videography. This action was taken in connection with 179 recovered cases, as part of the state's prohibition law enforcement.
